propositions: ADR-0083's isinstance-only capability detection became unsafe on Python 3.12+ because @runtime_checkable Protocol isinstance now uses inspect.getattr_static which does not see __getattr__ attributes, causing false negatives on dynamically-proxying transports

isinstance check is necessary but not sufficient on Python 3.12+; the prescribed guidance must include a member-level hasattr fallback to handle proxy objects that have the capability but fail the isinstance test

A tree-wide sweep found exactly one executable isinstance-against-Protocol capability dispatch site (dispatch_apply_phases.py:188) which is already hardened with hasattr fallback, and all other Protocol isinstance uses are either absent, custom-overridden via __instancecheck__, or proxy-safe by construction

The ADR amendment must frame this as temporal decay with a version boundary (safe in 3.11, unsafe in 3.12+), not an authoring error, and document the reference implementation at _capability_present as the sanctioned shape
